description: Vocus Fibre Pty Ltd - Combined areas is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by SIP Register – Vocus Fibre Pty Ltd. This dataset describes the service areas where Vocus Fibre Pty Ltd is the Statutory Infrastructure Provider (SIP). This dataset forms part of the SIP register which is managed by the ACMA. Further information on the SIP register is located on the ACMA’s website at. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher SIP Register – Vocus Fibre Pty Ltd. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
